author: DPA
title: Two killed, suspect dead in Minneapolis high-rise shooting - NewsBreak
text:
1 hours ago Two people were killed in a shooting at a high-rise building in the US city of Minneapolis on Wednesday, while the suspected gunman also died, police said at a press conference.
Three police officers were taken to hospital with injuries, two of them with gunshot wounds. It was initially unclear whether the suspect had been killed by police gunfire. The motive was also not immediately known.
One officer suffered a gunshot wound to the leg, while another was undergoing surgery, police said. A third officer suffered a non-life-threatening injury.
Officers were called to the scene on Wednesday afternoon after an initial report that someone had been shot. Once there, they heard further gunfire and followed the sounds to an upper floor of the building, where they encountered a haze that significantly limited their visibility, police said. They did not initially provide details of what happened afterwards.
FBI Director Kash Patel said on X that the agency was aware of the incident and had personnel at the scene. "We will offer any and all resources necessary to assist local authorities," he said.
The shooting took place in the Loring Park neighbourhood, immediately south-west of Minneapolis city centre. The city in the northern US state of Minnesota has a population of just over 400,000.
Fatal gun violence is common in the United States, where gun laws are relatively permissive and millions of firearms are in circulation. In the state of Minnesota, which has a population of about 5.8 million, 582 people died from gunshot wounds in 2024, according to authorities.
